summary.text: Scott Sandall is a Republican state senator from Utah Senate District 1 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A farmer and rancher, he served in the Utah House from 2015 to 2019 and has been a senator since 2019.

paragraphs.text: Scott Sandall earned a B.S., magna cum laude, from Brigham Young University.
His career experience includes working as a farmer and rancher.
Sandall joined the Utah State Farm Bureau board and was a scout leader for the Boy Scouts.
Sandall represented Utah House District 1 from 2015 to 2019, succeeded by Joel Ferry.
He then served in the Utah State Senate for District 17 from 2019 to 2023, succeeding Peter Knudson, and has represented Senate District 1 since 2023.
